#### 기본 R 패키지 graphics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hist(rchisq(100, df = 5))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](histogram_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=672}

#### 패키지 ggplot2


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data.frame(values = rchisq(100, df = 5)), aes(x = values)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
